A decimal spelling does not change the exact integer value.
Exponent spelling denotes the exact integer 100.
A binary64 conversion must not turn a fraction into an integer.
The ordinary integer maximum is inclusive.
The source integer exceeds the ordinary integer maximum.
The exact decimal is below binary64 maximum and rounds to the maximum finite value.
The source exceeds exact binary64 maximum even though conversion can round to a finite endpoint.
The nonzero source rounds to a nonzero binary64 subnormal.
A nonzero typed value must not underflow to zero.
Zero remains zero with the largest permitted exponent.
Even a zero token must obey the exponent bound.
A 128-byte numeric token is permitted.
Numeric token length exceeds 128 UTF-8 bytes.
Revision counters start at zero.
The uint64 maximum is inclusive.
Counters cannot exceed uint64 maximum.
Counter spelling is canonical decimal text.
Gregorian year 0001 is included.
Year 9999 and nine fraction digits are included.
Gregorian year zero is outside the contract.
A century divisible by 400 is a leap year.
1900 is not a Gregorian leap year.
April has only 30 days.
Second 60 is forbidden.
Only UTC Z spelling is accepted.
Accepted fractional spelling is retained, including trailing zeros.
Fractions have at most nine digits.
Canonical lowercase hyphenated UUIDv4 is valid for a new ID.
Uppercase UUID spelling is forbidden.

Positive source sequence includes uint64 maximum.
Source sequences start at one.

Unicode White_Space-only names are blank.

1025 pairs exceed the inclusive 1024-pair cap.

Escaped command decodes to the existing member name and cannot overwrite it.

Overlong UTF-8 encoding is malformed and cannot be repaired by decoding.
